title: Acceptance under larger halting budgets
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary string, and let $t,t'\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t\le t'$. Suppose every choice string of length exactly $t$ leaves the machine halted on input $x$. Then $N$ accepts $x$ within $t'$ steps if and only if it accepts $x$ within $t$ steps, where acceptance within a budget means that some choice string of exactly that length leaves the machine halted with output exactly the one-bit string $1$.
